department: Quillen College of Medicine — Biomedical Science Graduate Program

deadline.value: Preferred Fall 2027 deadline is February 1, 2027; final deadline for international applicants is April 1, 2027 (final domestic deadline is August 1, 2027).
deadline.quote: preferred deadline | Final Deadline Domestic Applicants | final deadline International applicants | Fall Feb 1 August 1 April 1

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for admission to the Biomedical Sciences Ph.D. program.
gre_general.quote: The GRE score is not required for application to the Biomedical Science Graduate Program.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Biomedical Sciences (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Centralized admission into the umbrella Biomedical Sciences Ph.D. program; students complete flexible laboratory rotations during the first year before choosing a concentration and mentor.
supervisor.quote: Students have the opportunity to explore their individual research interests through laboratory rotations. They are encouraged to sample a variety of faculty research programs by participating in rotations across departments.

also.quote: Students are admitted centrally rather than to departmental graduate programs and need not select an area of concentration until the end of the ﬁrst year of study.

funding.value: Most admitted Biomedical Sciences Ph.D. students receive a graduate assistantship providing a $27,000 per 12-month stipend plus payment of tuition and fees.
funding.quote: Most Biomedical Science Graduate Program students who are admitted to the program will be offered support through a graduate assistantship that includes a stipend as well as payment of tuition and fees. The stipend is currently $27,000 per 12 months.

entry_route.value: Direct entry beyond a bachelor's degree is standard (minimum 60 credit-hours beyond the baccalaureate degree; ETSU M.S. Biology graduates may have up to 16 fewer credits).
entry_route.quote: A minimum of 60 credit-hours are required beyond the baccalaureate degree.

notes: Umbrella Ph.D. in Quillen College of Medicine with five concentrations: Cardiovascular Sciences; Cellular, Molecular and Chemical Biology; Immunology, Inflammation and Infectious Diseases; Neuroscience; and Pharmaceutical Sciences. Requires 3.0 GPA (international), CV, 3 recommendations, personal statement (max 1,000 words), and potential interview.
name: Ph.D. in Biomedical Sciences
